_PORT_TODO_secrets: This file is the migrated `development.config` variant. It carries ONLY the settings that differed from `release.config`; everything else is inherited from appsettings.json. The connection string below is credential-free (Integrated Security) and is a LOCAL DEVELOPMENT default only. Never put a password here: use `dotnet user-secrets set "ConnectionStrings:SiteSqlServer" "..."` or the ConnectionStrings__SiteSqlServer environment variable instead.
